连接地址类型：

- Normal：主地址

- MPP: MPP地址
description.en:
The type of the endpoint. Valid values:

- Normal: the primary endpoint

- ReadWriteSplitting: the cluster endpoint

- MPP: the Massively Parallel Processing (MPP) endpoint

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb describe-db-cluster-net-info --db-cluster-id pc-0000000000000000 --connection-string-type Normal --region cn-hangzhou
